Units_Measure: % of public aware of term 'biodiversity'; survey index
Policy_Goal: SDG 4 (Quality Education): Relevant to SDG 4.7 (education for sustainable development); SDG 15.9 (integrate biodiversity values into planning). GBF Target 21 (knowledge for decision-making) and Target 22 (participation of indigenous peoples).
Data_Source: Louis Harris International surveys; IUCN
Climate_Rationale: Awareness surveys; no climate data.

Units_Measure: Engagement index aggregated from Twitter, online news and Google Trends (22 keywords, 31 languages)
Policy_Goal: SDG 4 (Quality Education): Relevant to SDG 4.7 (education for sustainable development); SDG 13.1 (climate awareness). GBF Target 21 (knowledge and data for decision-making).
Data_Source: Twitter API; online news aggregators; Google Trends
Climate_Rationale: Social media/web engagement data; no climate inputs.

Indicator_Name: WAZA bio-literacy survey (Biodiversity literacy in global zoo and aquarium visitors)
Units_Measure: % increase in biodiversity literacy score over zoo/aquarium visit
Policy_Goal: SDG 4 (Quality Education): Relevant to SDG 4.7 (education for sustainable development); SDG 12.8 (universal access to information for sustainable lifestyles). GBF Target 21 (knowledge) and Target 22 (participation).
Data_Source: World Association of Zoos and Aquariums (WAZA); Chester Zoo
Climate_Rationale: Zoo visitor surveys; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: Number of countries with biodiversity-relevant charges and fees
Policy_Sector: Nature & Biodiversity | Finance | Governance, Society & Data
Units_Measure: Count of countries with biodiversity fiscal instruments
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.9 (integrate biodiversity values into planning). GBF Target 18 (eliminate harmful subsidies – USD 500bn by 2030).
Data_Source: OECD Policy Instruments for the Environment (PINE)
Climate_Rationale: Fiscal policy data; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: Number of countries with biodiversity-relevant taxes
Policy_Sector: Nature & Biodiversity | Finance | Governance, Society & Data
Units_Measure: Count of countries with biodiversity-specific tax instruments
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.9 (integrate biodiversity values into planning). GBF Target 18 (eliminate harmful subsidies, scale up positive incentives).
Data_Source: OECD Policy Instruments for the Environment (PINE)
Climate_Rationale: Tax policy data; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: Number of countries with biodiversity-relevant tradable permit schemes
Units_Measure: Count of countries with tradable permit/offset schemes for biodiversity
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.9 (integrate biodiversity values into planning). GBF Target 18 (scale up positive incentives for biodiversity).
Data_Source: OECD Policy Instruments for the Environment (PINE)
Climate_Rationale: Policy data; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: Trends in potentially environmentally harmful elements of government support to agriculture (producer support estimate)
Policy_Sector: Land Use & Agriculture | Finance | Governance, Society & Data
Units_Measure: USD billion/year of potentially harmful agricultural subsidies
Policy_Goal: SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) and SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 2.4 (sustainable food production); SDG 15.9 (integrate biodiversity values into planning). GBF Target 18 (eliminate harmful subsidies – USD 500bn by 2030).
Data_Source: OECD Producer Support Estimate (PSE) database
Climate_Rationale: Agricultural subsidy data from OECD; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: Number of countries with developed or revised NBSAPs
Units_Measure: Count of countries with a current National Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.9 (integrate ecosystem and biodiversity values into national and local planning and development processes). GBF Target 14 (mainstream biodiversity across all sectors) and Target 17 (all Parties to have effective NBSAPs).
Data_Source: CBD Secretariat NBSAP database; national reports to CBD
Climate_Rationale: Policy/planning document records; no climate data.

Units_Measure: Global hectares (gha) per capita; ratio of footprint to biocapacity
Policy_Goal: SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption and Production): Relevant to SDG 12.2 (sustainable management and efficient use of natural resources); SDG 15.1 (terrestrial ecosystems). GBF Target 10 (sustainable agriculture), Target 16 (sustainable consumption).
Data_Source: Global Footprint Network National Footprint and Biocapacity Accounts; FAO; IEA
Climate_Rationale: Biocapacity affected by climate through agricultural productivity; no formal weather correction.

Indicator_Name: Human Appropriation of Net Primary Production (HANPP)
Units_Measure: % of terrestrial NPP appropriated by humans; GtC/year
Policy_Goal: SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption) and SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 12.2 (sustainable management of natural resources); SDG 15.1 (conservation of terrestrial ecosystems); SDG 15.3 (combat desertification). GBF Target 1 (spatial planning), Target 10 (sustainable agriculture and forestry).
Source_Reference: bipindicators.net/indicators/hanpp; Haberl et al. 2007; Krausmann et al. 2013
Data_Source: FAO production data; HYDE land-use dataset; global vegetation models
Climate_Rationale: NPP modelled from vegetation models using temperature and rainfall; climate variability affects annual HANPP values.

Indicator_Name: Percentage of Parties with legislation in Category 1 under CITES National Legislation Project (NLP)
Units_Measure: % of CITES Parties with Category 1 national legislation
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.7 (end poaching and trafficking of protected species); SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss). GBF Target 5 (sustainable use of wild species).
Data_Source: CITES Secretariat National Legislation Project assessments
Climate_Rationale: Legislative status from CITES review; no climate data.

Units_Measure: Index (0–1)
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water): Relevant to SDG 15.7 (end poaching and trafficking); SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss); SDG 14.4 (end overfishing). GBF Target 5 (sustainable use of wild species).
Data_Source: IUCN Red List; BirdLife International
Climate_Rationale: Red List classifications reflect utilisation threat; climate is a background factor.

Units_Measure: Index (0–1)
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.7 (end poaching and trafficking); SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss); SDG 12.2 (sustainable use of natural resources). GBF Target 5 (sustainable use of wild species).
Data_Source: IUCN Red List; CITES Trade Database; TRAFFIC
Climate_Rationale: RLI based on IUCN classifications; climate is secondary factor.

Units_Measure: Index (0–1; 1 = full habitat retention)
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss); SDG 15.1 (conservation of terrestrial and freshwater ecosystems); SDG 15.2 (sustainable management of forests); SDG 15.3 (combat desertification); SDG 15.4 (mountain ecosystems). GBF Targets 1 and 2.
Data_Source: CSIRO species distribution models; ESA CCI land cover; GBIF
Climate_Rationale: BHI uses land-use inputs with statistical species models; climate is a background driver, not a direct model input.

Indicator_Name: CGMFC-21 – Continuous Global Mangrove Forest Cover for the 21st Century
Units_Measure: Area (ha) of mangrove cover; annual change (%)
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water): Relevant to SDG 15.1 (conservation of coastal ecosystems); SDG 14.2 (protect marine and coastal ecosystems); SDG 13.1 (climate resilience). GBF Targets 2 and 3.
Data_Source: JAXA Global Mangrove Watch (Landsat/ALOS remote sensing); Hamilton & Casey 2016
Climate_Rationale: Climate change drives sea-level rise and storm damage affecting mangrove distribution.

Indicator_Name: Forest area as a proportion of total land area
Units_Measure: % of total land area covered by forest
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.2 (promote sustainable management of forests, halt deforestation); SDG 15.1 (conservation of terrestrial ecosystems); SDG 13.1 (climate action – forests as carbon sinks). GBF Targets 2, 3 and 10.
Source_Reference: bipindicators.net/indicators/forest-area; FAO Global Forest Resources Assessment
Data_Source: FAO Global Forest Resources Assessment (FRA); national forest inventories
Climate_Rationale: Forest area from national inventories; climate is a long-term driver but not a direct input to area calculations.

Units_Measure: Index (baseline = 100); % change in natural wetland area
Policy_Goal: SDG 6 (Clean Water) and SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 6.6 (protect and restore water-related ecosystems including wetlands); SDG 15.1 (conservation of inland freshwater ecosystems); SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss). GBF Targets 2 and 3; Ramsar Convention.
Data_Source: WETLANDS International GWDE; Ramsar; remote sensing
Climate_Rationale: Wetland extent strongly affected by rainfall and drought; hydrological models use precipitation as direct input.

Indicator_Name: Proportion of land that is degraded over total land area
Units_Measure: % of total land area that is degraded
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Official indicator for SDG 15.3.1 – combat desertification and restore degraded land; relevant to SDG 15.1 (conservation of terrestrial ecosystems). GBF Target 2 (restore degraded ecosystems).
Data_Source: UNCCD national reporting; MODIS/Landsat land cover change; FAO
Climate_Rationale: Land degradation includes vegetation loss affected by drought and temperature; NDVI-based indicators respond to inter-annual climate variability.

Units_Measure: Index (0–1)
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.2 (sustainable management of forests, halt deforestation); SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss). GBF Target 4 (threatened species recovery) and Target 2 (restore degraded ecosystems).
Data_Source: IUCN Red List; BirdLife International
Climate_Rationale: Climate change affects forest species through range shifts, phenological mismatches and increased fire risk.

Units_Measure: Index of change in extent of natural ecosystem types (% of baseline)
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.1 (conservation, restoration and sustainable use of terrestrial and inland freshwater ecosystems); SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss). GBF Goal A (ecosystem integrity), Target 1 (spatial planning) and Target 2 (restore degraded ecosystems).
Source_Reference: bipindicators.net; IUCN Red List of Ecosystems; Keith et al.
Data_Source: ESA CCI land cover; MODIS; national ecosystem assessments; IUCN Red List of Ecosystems
Climate_Rationale: Ecosystem extent affected by climate-driven land-cover change; remote sensing data respond to climate variability.

Units_Measure: Composite index of ecosystem health / condition (0–1)
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.1 (conservation and restoration of terrestrial and freshwater ecosystems); SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss). GBF Goal A (ecosystem integrity) and Target 2 (restore degraded ecosystems).
Data_Source: Multiple global ecosystem condition datasets; UNEP-WCMC synthesis
Climate_Rationale: Ecosystem health affected by climate-driven disturbances including drought, fire and temperature extremes.

Indicator_Name: Living Planet Index (trends in target and bycatch species)
Policy_Goal: SDG 14 (Life Below Water): Relevant to SDG 14.4 (end overfishing and regulate harvesting); SDG 14.2 (protect marine ecosystems). GBF Target 5 (sustainable use of wild species).
Data_Source: ZSL LPI database – marine vertebrate populations
Climate_Rationale: Sea temperature affects fish population dynamics and detectability in surveys.

Units_Measure: Mean trophic level of fish landings (dimensionless)
Policy_Goal: SDG 14 (Life Below Water): Relevant to SDG 14.4 (end overfishing); SDG 14.2 (sustainably manage marine and coastal ecosystems). GBF Target 5 (sustainable use of wild species) and Goal A.
Data_Source: FAO FishStat; Sea Around Us Project (UBC)
Climate_Rationale: Sea temperature affects species composition and trophic structure of fish communities.

Units_Measure: Million tonnes of MSC-certified seafood; % of global wild catch
Policy_Goal: SDG 14 (Life Below Water): Relevant to SDG 14.4 (manage fish stocks sustainably); SDG 14.2 (protect marine ecosystems). GBF Target 5 (sustainable use of wild species) and Target 10 (sustainable fisheries).
Data_Source: Marine Stewardship Council (MSC) certification database
Climate_Rationale: Certification data from MSC records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: Number and volume of MSC certified, consumer-facing products by distribution country
Units_Measure: Number of MSC-labelled consumer products; volume (tonnes)
Policy_Goal: SDG 14 (Life Below Water): Relevant to SDG 14.4 (manage fish stocks sustainably; sustainable supply chains); SDG 12.2 (sustainable management of natural resources). GBF Target 5 (sustainable use of wild species) and Target 16 (sustainable consumption).
Data_Source: MSC product database; MSC annual report
Climate_Rationale: Product certification data from MSC records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: Number of MSC Chain of Custody Certification holders by distribution country
Units_Measure: Count of businesses certified to MSC Chain of Custody standard
Policy_Goal: SDG 14 (Life Below Water): Relevant to SDG 14.4 (sustainable supply chains for seafood); SDG 12.2 (sustainable management and use of natural resources). GBF Target 5 (sustainable use of wild species) and Target 16 (sustainable consumption).
Data_Source: MSC Chain of Custody certification database
Climate_Rationale: Certification data from MSC records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: Proportion of fish stocks within biologically sustainable levels
Units_Measure: % of assessed fish stocks at biologically sustainable levels
Policy_Goal: SDG 14 (Life Below Water): Official indicator for SDG 14.4.1 – proportion of fish stocks within biologically sustainable levels; relevant to SDG 14.2 (protect marine ecosystems). GBF Target 5 (sustainable use of wild species).
Source_Reference: bipindicators.net; FAO The State of World Fisheries and Aquaculture
Data_Source: FAO Fisheries Division; ICES, CCAMLR, WCPFC stock assessments
Climate_Rationale: Sea temperature embedded in stock productivity and recruitment models.

Units_Measure: Index (0–1)
Policy_Goal: SDG 14 (Life Below Water): Relevant to SDG 14.4 (end overfishing); SDG 14.2 (protect marine ecosystems); SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss). GBF Target 5 (sustainable use of wild species).
Data_Source: IUCN Red List; TRAFFIC; FishBase
Climate_Rationale: RLI based on IUCN classifications; climate is a background factor.

Units_Measure: Biomass index of large reef fish (kg/ha); trend over time
Policy_Goal: SDG 14 (Life Below Water): Relevant to SDG 14.2 (sustainably manage marine and coastal ecosystems); SDG 14.4 (end overfishing); SDG 14.5 (conserve coastal and marine areas). GBF Target 5 (sustainable use) and Target 3 (protect marine areas).
Data_Source: Global Coral Reef Monitoring Network (GCRMN); Reef Life Survey; OBIS
Climate_Rationale: SST is a primary driver of reef ecosystem health; bleaching events directly reduce large reef fish biomass.

Indicator_Name: Cumulative Human Impacts on Marine Ecosystems
Units_Measure: Cumulative human impact score (0–100 scale); area-weighted index
Policy_Goal: SDG 14 (Life Below Water): Relevant to SDG 14.1 (reduce marine pollution); SDG 14.2 (protect marine ecosystems); SDG 14.3 (minimize ocean acidification). GBF Target 7 (reduce pollution) and Target 3 (protect marine areas).
Data_Source: National Center for Ecological Analysis and Synthesis (NCEAS); Halpern et al.
Climate_Rationale: Ocean warming, acidification and sea-level rise are direct components of the cumulative impacts score.

Indicator_Name: Area of forest under sustainable management: total FSC and PEFC forest management certification
Policy_Sector: Land Use & Agriculture | Governance, Society & Data
Units_Measure: Million ha; % of total forest area certified
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.2 (promote sustainable management of all types of forests); SDG 15.1 (conservation of terrestrial ecosystems); SDG 12.2 (sustainable management of natural resources). GBF Target 10 (sustainable agriculture, aquaculture, forestry and fisheries).
Data_Source: Forest Stewardship Council (FSC); Programme for the Endorsement of Forest Certification (PEFC); FAO FRA
Climate_Rationale: Certification data from FSC/PEFC records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: Wild Bird Index (forest and farmland specialist birds)
Units_Measure: Index (baseline year = 100)
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss); SDG 15.2 (sustainable management of forests); SDG 2.4 (sustainable agricultural systems). GBF Goal A, Target 4 (species populations at healthy levels).
Data_Source: Pan-European Common Bird Monitoring Scheme (PECBMS); BirdLife International; national BBS schemes
Climate_Rationale: Weather directly affects bird detectability and breeding success; spring temperature is a key confounder of annual index values.

Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss); SDG 15.1 (terrestrial and freshwater ecosystems); SDG 2.4 (sustainable agricultural practices). GBF Goal A, Target 4.
Data_Source: ZSL LPI database – farmland vertebrate populations
Climate_Rationale: Agricultural land-use change and seasonal weather affect farmland species; annual index values reflect climate variability.

Units_Measure: Index (0–1)
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water): Relevant to SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss); SDG 14.1 (reduce marine pollution); SDG 12.4 (management of chemicals). GBF Target 7 (reduce pollution to safe levels).
Data_Source: IUCN Red List; pollution threat classifications
Climate_Rationale: RLI based on Red List classifications; chemical pollution impacts are largely independent of climate.

Indicator_Name: Trends in Loss of Reactive Nitrogen to the Environment
Units_Measure: Tg N/year emitted; % exceedance of critical loads
Policy_Goal: SDG 14 (Life Below Water) and SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 14.1 (reduce marine pollution from land-based activities); SDG 6.6 (protect freshwater ecosystems). GBF Target 7 (reduce pollution – nutrients).
Data_Source: IIASA; EDGAR; EMEP; FAO nitrogen budget data
Climate_Rationale: Rainfall directly determines wet nitrogen deposition; wet/dry ratios are climate-sensitive.

Units_Measure: kg N/ha/year deposited; % of ecosystem area exceeding critical loads
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.1 (conservation of terrestrial ecosystems); SDG 14.1 (reduce marine pollution from land); SDG 6.6 (protect freshwater ecosystems). GBF Target 7 (reduce pollution to safe levels – nitrogen).
Data_Source: EMEP atmospheric chemistry-transport model; IIASA-EDGAR; critical loads databases
Climate_Rationale: EMEP model uses rainfall as direct input; wet deposition varies directly with precipitation.

Units_Measure: Composite index of water quality in aquatic ecosystems for biodiversity; % of water bodies meeting quality criteria
Policy_Goal: SDG 6 (Clean Water): Relevant to SDG 6.3 (improve water quality, reduce pollution); SDG 6.6 (protect water-related ecosystems); SDG 15.1 (conservation of inland freshwater ecosystems); SDG 14.1 (reduce marine pollution). GBF Target 7 (reduce pollution).
Data_Source: UN GEMS/Water global monitoring system; national water quality monitoring networks; EEA Waterbase
Climate_Rationale: Rainfall affects pollutant concentrations through dilution and runoff; temperature affects BOD and algal growth.

Indicator_Name: Legislation for prevention and control of invasive alien species (IAS)
Policy_Sector: Nature & Biodiversity | Biosecurity | Governance, Society & Data
Units_Measure: Number/% of countries with IAS legislation, management plans
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.8 (introduce measures to prevent IAS); SDG 15.9 (integrate biodiversity values into planning). GBF Target 6 (eliminate and control invasive alien species).
Data_Source: InforMEA treaty database; IUCN Invasive Species Specialist Group
Climate_Rationale: Policy adoption data; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: Red List Index (impacts of invasive alien species)
Units_Measure: Index (0–1)
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.8 (prevent introduction and reduce impacts of IAS); SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss). GBF Target 4 (threatened species) and Target 6 (control IAS).
Data_Source: IUCN Red List; GBIF; GRIIS
Climate_Rationale: Climate warming facilitates IAS establishment but RLI is based on Red List classifications.

Indicator_Name: Trends in invasive alien species vertebrate eradications
Policy_Sector: Nature & Biodiversity | Biosecurity | Governance, Society & Data
Units_Measure: Cumulative number of successful IAS vertebrate eradications
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.8 (prevent and control IAS); SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss). GBF Target 6 (eliminate and control invasive alien species).
Source_Reference: bipindicators.net; Bellard et al.; Island Conservation
Data_Source: Island Conservation eradication database; IUCN ISSG
Climate_Rationale: Eradication programme data; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: Trends in the numbers of invasive alien species introduction events
Units_Measure: Number of new IAS establishment events per year; cumulative total
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.8 (prevent introduction of IAS); SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss). GBF Target 6 (reduce introduction rates by at least 50% by 2030).
Source_Reference: bipindicators.net; Seebens et al. 2017, Nature Communications
Data_Source: GBIF; GRIIS; Seebens et al. alien species database
Climate_Rationale: Climate warming facilitates IAS spread but counts are from species databases.

Units_Measure: % of terrestrial, inland water and marine areas under protected area
Policy_Goal: SDG 14 (Life Below Water) and SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.1 (conservation of terrestrial and freshwater ecosystems); SDG 14.5 (conserve coastal and marine areas). GBF Target 3 (30×30 – protect land and sea).
Data_Source: WDPA (UNEP-WCMC / IUCN); Protected Planet
Climate_Rationale: Coverage from GIS designation databases; no climate data.

Units_Measure: % of each terrestrial ecoregion under protected area
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.1 (conservation of terrestrial and freshwater ecosystems); SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss); SDG 15.9 (integrate ecosystem values into planning). GBF Target 3 (30×30).
Data_Source: WDPA (Protected Planet); WWF terrestrial ecoregions (Olson et al. 2001); IUCN
Climate_Rationale: Coverage calculated from GIS data; no climate inputs.

Indicator_Name: Protected Area Coverage of Key Biodiversity Areas
Units_Measure: % of KBAs covered by protected areas (terrestrial, freshwater and marine)
Policy_Goal: SDG 14 (Life Below Water) and SDG 15 (Life on Land): Official indicator for SDG 15.1.2 (important sites for terrestrial and freshwater biodiversity); also official for SDG 14.5.1 (marine KBAs) and SDG 15.4.1 (mountain biodiversity sites). GBF Target 3 (30×30 – protect land and sea).
Data_Source: WDPA (UNEP-WCMC / IUCN); KBA database (BirdLife International; IUCN); Protected Planet
Climate_Rationale: Protected area and KBA coverage from designation databases; no climate data.

Units_Measure: Connectedness index (0–1) for terrestrial protected area network
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.1 (conservation of terrestrial ecosystems and connectivity); SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss). GBF Goal A (connectivity and resilience) and Target 3 (30×30 – well-connected protected areas).
Source_Reference: bipindicators.net; CSIRO/GEO BON; Saura et al.
Data_Source: CSIRO; WDPA (Protected Planet); GEO BON; Map of Life
Climate_Rationale: Connectivity from land-cover and protected area GIS data; no climate inputs.

Units_Measure: Representativeness index (0–1) across habitat types
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.1 (conservation of representative terrestrial and freshwater ecosystems). GBF Target 3 (30×30 – ecologically representative protected area systems).
Data_Source: CSIRO; WDPA; GEO BON; Map of Life; habitat classification maps
Climate_Rationale: Representativeness from GIS analysis; no climate inputs.

Units_Measure: % of protected areas assessed for management effectiveness; score
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.1 (conservation of ecosystems, effective management); SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss); SDG 16.7 (accountable governance institutions). GBF Target 3 (30×30 – effective management).
Data_Source: IUCN Global Database on Protected Area Management Effectiveness (GD-PAME); WCPA
Climate_Rationale: Management effectiveness from PAME assessments; no climate input.

Policy_Sector: Nature & Biodiversity | Land Use & Agriculture | Governance, Society & Data
Units_Measure: % of land that is both protected and connected within dispersal distance threshold
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.1 (conservation with ecological connectivity); SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss). GBF Goal A (connectivity and resilience) and Target 3 (well-connected protected area systems).
Data_Source: WDPA (Protected Planet); ESRI Land Cover; Saura et al. model
Climate_Rationale: Connectivity calculated from protected area GIS and land cover; no climate inputs.

Indicator_Name: Proportion of important sites for terrestrial and freshwater biodiversity covered by protected areas, by ecosystem type
Units_Measure: % of important sites for terrestrial and freshwater biodiversity under protected area, by ecosystem type
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Official component of SDG 15.1.2 disaggregated by ecosystem type; relevant to SDG 15.1. GBF Target 3 (30×30 – protect important biodiversity sites).
Source_Reference: bipindicators.net; WDPA; BirdLife International KBA database
Data_Source: WDPA (Protected Planet); KBA database; IUCN
Climate_Rationale: Coverage from GIS designation databases; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: Wildlife Picture Index in tropical forest protected areas
Units_Measure: Biodiversity index from camera trap data; trend in species richness and evenness
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss); SDG 15.1 (conservation of terrestrial ecosystems). GBF Target 3 (effective protection) and Target 4 (threatened species).
Data_Source: Tropical Ecology Assessment and Monitoring (TEAM) Network camera trap data; Wildlife Insights
Climate_Rationale: Camera trap data from standardised surveys; surveys normalised by effort.

Units_Measure: Index of the proportion of each species's range covered by protected areas (0–100)
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss and protect threatened species); SDG 15.1 (conservation of terrestrial and freshwater ecosystems). GBF Target 3 (30×30 – protect important biodiversity areas) and Target 4 (threatened species recovery).
Source_Reference: bipindicators.net; Rodrigues et al. 2004; IUCN / BirdLife International
Data_Source: WDPA (Protected Planet); IUCN species range maps; BirdLife International range maps
Climate_Rationale: Protected area coverage of species ranges from GIS analysis; no climate inputs.

Units_Measure: Index (0–1; 1 = no human impact on local biodiversity)
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss); SDG 15.1 (conservation of terrestrial ecosystems). GBF Goal A (ecosystem integrity) and Target 4 (species populations).
Data_Source: PREDICTS project (Natural History Museum London); IUCN; land-use maps
Climate_Rationale: BII based on statistical models of biodiversity response to land use; climate is a secondary driver.

Policy_Goal: SDG 14 (Life Below Water) and SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss); SDG 14.4 (end overfishing); SDG 14.2 (protect marine ecosystems); SDG 15.1 (conserve freshwater ecosystems). GBF Goal A (increase abundance of wild species to healthy levels).
Data_Source: Zoological Society of London (ZSL) LPI database; WWF Living Planet Report
Climate_Rationale: Climate change is embedded as a threat driver; weather affects detectability in survey protocols.

Indicator_Name: Number of species extinctions (birds and mammals)
Units_Measure: Cumulative number of confirmed bird and mammal extinctions
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.5 (halt loss of biodiversity and prevent extinction of threatened species); SDG 15.9 (integrate biodiversity values into national accounting). GBF Goal A (halt human-induced extinction) and Target 4.
Source_Reference: bipindicators.net; IUCN Red List; BirdLife International
Data_Source: IUCN Red List of Threatened Species – Extinct categories; BirdLife International
Climate_Rationale: Extinction records from authoritative taxonomic assessments; no climate data input.

Units_Measure: Index (0–1; 1 = no extinction risk)
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Official indicator for SDG 15.5.1 – halt loss of biodiversity and protect threatened species; relevant to SDG 2.4, SDG 2.5, SDG 14.2 (marine ecosystems) and SDG 14.3 (coral species). GBF Goal A, Target 4 (threatened species recovery).
Data_Source: IUCN Red List of Threatened Species; BirdLife International; custodian IUCN / BirdLife
Climate_Rationale: Climate change is a recognised threat driver; RLI values reflect climate-driven status changes for many taxa.

Units_Measure: Biodiversity index from camera trap data (species richness and evenness)
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss); SDG 15.1 (conservation of terrestrial ecosystems). GBF Goal A and Target 4 (species populations at healthy levels).
Data_Source: TEAM Network; Wildlife Insights camera trap database; WCS
Climate_Rationale: Camera trap data normalised by survey effort; climate affects species activity but is not a direct input.

Units_Measure: Index (1970 = 1) for forest-dependent vertebrates
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss); SDG 15.2 (sustainable management of forests); SDG 15.1 (conservation of terrestrial ecosystems). GBF Goal A and Target 4.
Data_Source: ZSL LPI database – forest specialist vertebrate populations
Climate_Rationale: Forest specialist populations respond to climate-driven forest change; annual index values affected by climate variability.

Units_Measure: Number of species whose extinction was prevented through conservation interventions
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.5 (halt loss of biodiversity and prevent extinction of threatened species). GBF Goal A (halt human-induced extinction) and Target 4.
Source_Reference: bipindicators.net; Bolam et al. 2021; IUCN Red List
Data_Source: IUCN Red List; conservation intervention databases; Bolam et al. dataset
Climate_Rationale: Extinction prevention estimates from conservation action records; no climate data.

Units_Measure: Index (0–1)
Policy_Goal: SDG 14 (Life Below Water): Relevant to SDG 14.3 (minimize and address impacts of ocean acidification); SDG 14.2 (protect marine and coastal ecosystems); SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss). GBF Target 4 (threatened species) and Target 8 (climate change impacts on biodiversity).
Source_Reference: bipindicators.net; Carpenter et al. 2008; IUCN Coral Specialist Group
Data_Source: IUCN Red List; IUCN Coral Specialist Group; Global Coral Reef Monitoring Network
Climate_Rationale: Ocean warming and acidification are primary drivers of coral bleaching and extinction risk; SST data are the direct climate input.

Units_Measure: Index of change in habitat-based species persistence (0–1)
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss); SDG 15.1 (conservation of terrestrial and freshwater ecosystems). GBF Goal A (ecosystem integrity) and Target 2 (restore degraded ecosystems).
Source_Reference: bipindicators.net; UNEP-WCMC / NatureServe / Map of Life
Data_Source: Species range maps; habitat/land-cover change data; IUCN; BirdLife International; Map of Life
Climate_Rationale: Species habitat modelled from land-cover data; climate is a background driver of habitat change but not a direct model input.

Units_Measure: Index of data availability and completeness for species assessments
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss and protect threatened species); SDG 15.9 (integrate biodiversity values into national planning). GBF Target 21 (knowledge and data for decision-making).
Source_Reference: bipindicators.net; IUCN Red List; GBF monitoring framework
Data_Source: IUCN Red List database; Species data coverage metrics
Climate_Rationale: Data coverage metrics from IUCN records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: Red List Index (wild relatives of domesticated animals)
Units_Measure: Index (0–1)
Policy_Goal: SDG 2 (Zero Hunger): Relevant to SDG 2.5 (maintain genetic diversity of farmed/domesticated species and their wild relatives); relevant to SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss). GBF Goal A (genetic diversity) and Target 4.
Data_Source: IUCN Red List; FAO list of wild relatives of domesticated animals
Climate_Rationale: Climate change affects wild populations through range shifts and habitat change.

Units_Measure: Index of risk of ecosystem collapse (0–1)
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss); SDG 15.1 (conservation, restoration and sustainable use of terrestrial and inland freshwater ecosystems). GBF Goal A (ecosystem integrity) and Target 2 (restore degraded ecosystems).
Source_Reference: bipindicators.net; Keith et al. 2013; IUCN Red List of Ecosystems
Data_Source: IUCN Red List of Ecosystems assessments; national ecosystem assessments; Zenodo repository
Climate_Rationale: Ecosystem collapse risk affected by climate-driven threats including fire, drought and sea-level rise.

Units_Measure: % of reef area with live coral cover; trend over time
Policy_Goal: SDG 14 (Life Below Water): Relevant to SDG 14.2 (sustainably manage and protect marine and coastal ecosystems); SDG 14.3 (minimize and address impacts of ocean acidification); SDG 14.5 (conserve coastal and marine areas). GBF Target 3 (protect marine areas) and Target 8 (minimise climate change impacts).
Source_Reference: bipindicators.net; Global Coral Reef Monitoring Network (GCRMN)
Data_Source: Global Coral Reef Monitoring Network (GCRMN); ReefBase; CoralNet
Climate_Rationale: Sea surface temperature is the primary driver of coral bleaching; SST anomalies are directly embedded in the indicator trend.

Units_Measure: Mean thermal affinity of the local reef fish community (°C); trend over time
Policy_Goal: SDG 14 (Life Below Water): Relevant to SDG 14.3 (minimize and address impacts of ocean acidification and ocean warming); SDG 14.2 (sustainably manage marine ecosystems). GBF Target 8 (minimise climate change impacts on biodiversity).
Source_Reference: bipindicators.net; Floeter et al.; Cheung et al.
Data_Source: Reef Life Survey; OBIS; Reef Check; FishBase; sea surface temperature datasets
Climate_Rationale: This indicator directly measures community-level thermal responses to ocean warming; SST is the primary input.

Indicator_Name: Proportion of local breeds classified as being at risk, not-at-risk or at unknown level of risk of extinction
Units_Measure: % of local livestock breeds by risk category
Policy_Goal: SDG 2 (Zero Hunger): Official indicator for SDG 2.5.2 – proportion of local breeds classified as being at risk of extinction; relevant to SDG 2.5 (maintain genetic diversity of seeds, plants and farmed/domesticated animals). GBF Goal A (genetic diversity) and Target 4.
Data_Source: FAO Domestic Animal Diversity Information System (DAD-IS); FAO Commission on Genetic Resources
Climate_Rationale: Breed risk status based on population records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: Number of Contracting Parties to the International Treaty on Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture
Policy_Sector: Land Use & Agriculture | Governance, Society & Data
Units_Measure: Count of state parties to the ITPGRFA
Policy_Goal: SDG 2 (Zero Hunger): Relevant to SDG 2.5 (maintain genetic diversity of seeds, plants and farmed/domesticated animals); SDG 15.6 (fair and equitable sharing of benefits from genetic resources). GBF Goal A (genetic diversity) and Target 13 (genetic resources).
Data_Source: FAO International Treaty on Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture Secretariat
Climate_Rationale: Treaty membership from FAO records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: Number of countries that have reported legislative, administrative and policy frameworks for measures to implement the International Treaty
Units_Measure: Count of countries that have reported ITPGRFA implementation frameworks
Policy_Goal: SDG 2 (Zero Hunger): Relevant to SDG 2.5 (maintain genetic diversity of seeds and farmed species); SDG 15.6 (fair and equitable sharing of benefits from genetic resources). GBF Goal A (genetic diversity) and Target 13 (genetic resources and benefit sharing).
Data_Source: FAO ITPGRFA Secretariat national reporting database
Climate_Rationale: National reporting data from FAO; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: Total number of crop material from the Multilateral System of the International Treaty received in a country
Policy_Sector: Land Use & Agriculture | Governance, Society & Data
Units_Measure: Number of SMTA (Standard Material Transfer Agreement) transfers received by country

Source_Reference: bipindicators.net; FAO ITPGRFA Multilateral System; GLIS
Data_Source: FAO Global Information System on Plant Genetic Resources (GLIS); ITPGRFA SMTA database
Climate_Rationale: Transfer agreement records from FAO; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: Comprehensiveness of conservation of socioeconomically as well as culturally valuable species
Units_Measure: Index of gap coverage for socioeconomically/culturally valuable species in ex-situ and in-situ collections
Policy_Goal: SDG 2 (Zero Hunger): Relevant to SDG 2.5 (maintain genetic diversity for food and agriculture); SDG 15.6 (equitable sharing of genetic resources). GBF Goal A (genetic diversity) and Target 13 (genetic resources and benefit sharing).
Data_Source: GENEBANK platform; national genebank collections; GBIF; crop wild relative datasets
Climate_Rationale: Gap analysis using occurrence and collection data; no climate inputs.
Framework_Classification: Theme: Genetic Resources; Status: In development

Indicator_Name: Coverage by protected areas of important sites for mountain biodiversity
Policy_Sector: Nature & Biodiversity | Trade & Industry | Governance, Society & Data
Units_Measure: % of important mountain biodiversity sites under protected area
Policy_Goal: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Official indicator for SDG 15.4.1 – coverage by protected areas of important sites for mountain biodiversity; relevant to SDG 15.4 (conservation of mountain ecosystems). GBF Target 3 (30×30 – protect mountain areas).
Data_Source: WDPA (Protected Planet); KBA database; mountain ecoregion layers
Climate_Rationale: Coverage from GIS designation databases; no climate data.

Units_Measure: Index (0–1)

Data_Source: IUCN Red List; pollinators specialist groups
Climate_Rationale: Climate change causes phenological mismatches and range shifts for pollinators.

Indicator_Name: Red List Index (species used for food and medicine)
Units_Measure: Index (0–1)
Policy_Goal: SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) and SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 2.4 (sustainable food systems) and SDG 2.5 (genetic diversity); SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss); SDG 12.2 (sustainable use of natural resources). GBF Target 4 (threatened species) and Target 5 (sustainable use).
Data_Source: IUCN Red List; FAO; TRAFFIC
Climate_Rationale: Climate change affects wild food species through habitat shifts and phenological change.

Units_Measure: Index of ecosystem resilience under climate change scenarios
Policy_Goal: SDG 13 (Climate Action) and SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 13.1 (strengthen resilience and adaptive capacity); SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss); SDG 15.3 (restore degraded land). GBF Target 2 (restore degraded ecosystems) and Target 8 (minimise climate change impacts).
Data_Source: Climate scenario data (CMIP); vegetation models; CSIRO
Climate_Rationale: BERI directly uses climate data (temperature, precipitation projections) as primary inputs; the indicator measures ecosystem responses to climate change.

Units_Measure: Composite score (0–100) across 10 ocean ecosystem health goals
Policy_Goal: SDG 14 (Life Below Water): Relevant to SDG 14.1 (reduce marine pollution); SDG 14.2 (sustainably manage marine and coastal ecosystems); SDG 14.4 (end overfishing); SDG 14.5 (conserve coastal and marine areas). GBF Target 3 (protect marine areas) and Target 5 (sustainable use).
Data_Source: National Center for Ecological Analysis and Synthesis (NCEAS); multiple global datasets
Climate_Rationale: Ocean warming and acidification are components of the OHI; SST is embedded in several goal scores.

Indicator_Name: Climatic impacts on European and North American birds
Units_Measure: Climate change vulnerability index / Species Climate Impact Score (SCIS)
Policy_Goal: SDG 13 (Climate Action) and SDG 15 (Life on Land): Relevant to SDG 13.1 (strengthen resilience and adaptive capacity); SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss). GBF Target 8 (minimise climate change impacts on biodiversity).
Data_Source: European Bird Census Council (EBCC); North American Breeding Bird Survey; PECBMS; climate model projections
Climate_Rationale: This indicator directly measures bird population responses to climate change; temperature anomalies and climate projections are the primary inputs.

Units_Measure: Count of CBD Parties that have ratified the Nagoya Protocol on ABS

Data_Source: CBD Secretariat ABS Clearing-House; CBD treaty status records
Climate_Rationale: Treaty ratification from CBD records; no climate data.

Units_Measure: Number of indigenous languages; number of speakers; UNESCO endangerment index

Data_Source: Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF); digitised natural history collections
